page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top right, signature at foot.

main_text.p: tis cultores antè extitissent, tandem verum belli pacisque arbitrum, Deum, qui exercituum est Iehova, verâ fide amplexi, Chalcedone habuerunt Synodum: quæ anno II. Marciani, in æde Euphemiæ, DCXXX. Patrum præsentiâ, habita fuit contra Eutychen, Dioscorum & Nestorem. Eximius Ecclesiæ illius Episcopus fuit Maretes, qui Iuliano apostatæ, cœcitatem ei exprobranti, liberrimè respondit, gratias se agere Deo, quòd tam impium Principem non cogeretur intueri. Quæ Bithynorum Chalcedonensium urbs Procerastis antè dicta, hodie Cacelina, sive Galata vocatur, popularesque urbes habet Niceam, Nicomediam, Prusiam (Bursam inverè nunc vocant) quæ & Zolia. quibus locis omnibus illustres Ecclesiæ Christi fuerunt. De Bebrycibus, Thynis, Mygdonibus, Mariandinis & Caucosnibus, quæ peculiares olim atque distinctæ à se gentes fuerunt, certis finibus separatæ, & tandem omnes in unius Bithyniæ nomine, non secus atque diversi fluvii, in uno aliquo pelago, delitescentes evanuerunt. Græcoq; idiomate sunt usæ, videat qui velis Strabonis librum VII.

page.notes: Faint ink smudge near "Maretes" and marks at the page edges were left out. The word after "& " in "& Zolia" has a Greek-looking initial letter and is copied as Zolia; it may need checking. "Caucosnibus" is a line-end break: the printed form is "Cauco-" / "nibus", so the word is written whole as Caucanibus? No: copied as printed "Cauco-nibus" with the hyphen kept. The entry beginning "BOHEMI" is printed in small capitals with a bracket and is set as a paragraph of running text, not a heading. The final "Bojobemiâ" is set in italic with a circumflex as printed, as far as can be read.
